title: Consolidated Data Model
description: Consolidated entity schemas from data model files

city.description:
City information linked to state.
Linked to state via state foreign key as parent.

zipcode.description: ZIP code as integer, primary key and foreign key to zipcode_area

violent_crime.description: Violent crime score (1-100 scale, US average: 22.7)

property_crime.description: Property crime score (1-100 scale, US average: 35.4)

crime_stats.description:
Crime scores for ZIP code areas from BestPlaces.net.
Scores are on a scale of 1 (low) to 100 (high crime).
US averages: violent 22.7, property 35.4.
Linked to zipcode_area via zipcode foreign key. One crime stats record per ZIP code.

zipcode.description: ZIP code as integer, foreign key to zipcode_area

demographic_stats.description:
Demographic breakdown by ZIP code area showing racial/ethnic composition.
Percentages represent the proportion of the population in each category.

id.description: Unique identifier for the fault key point (short string)

description.description: Description of the key point location

fault.description:
A key point along a fault system with GPS coordinates.
Linked to fault_system via fault_system_name foreign key.

avg_movement.description: Average movement rate in millimeters per year (mm/year)

faults.description: Array of key points along the fault

fault_system.description:
Major surface expressions of Houston growth faults with GPS coordinates.
These faults are active and can cause foundation issues for properties.

area_id.description: Unique identifier for the geographic area (format: type_name, e.g., 'neighborhood_the_heights')

zip_codes.description: List of ZIP codes associated with this area (as integers, optional)

notes.description: Additional notes about the area (e.g., development, affordability, investment potential for upcoming areas)

bounds.description: Geographic bounds for this area (typically one bounds object per area)

schools.description: Schools associated with this geographic area (school districts/school zones)

geographic_area.description:
A unified entity representing various types of geographic areas including neighborhoods,
market sectors, exurb hubs, market rings, and neighborhood polygons. Each area has a type,
name, description, optional zip codes, and geographic bounds. Replaces separate entities
for upcoming_area, market_sector, exurb_hub, market_ring, and neighborhood_polygon.

area_id.description: Primary key and foreign key reference to geographic_area.area_id

geographic_bounds.description:
Geographic boundary definition using rectangular bounds (north, south, east, west).
Represents a bounding box for geographic areas. Nested under geographic_area entities.
Each geographic area typically has one bounds object, but multiple bounds are supported
for complex polygons that require multiple bounding boxes.

hcad_account.description: HCAD real property account number (source column `acct`); trim fixed-width padding.

yr.description: Tax roll year from column `yr` in real_acct.txt (four-digit calendar year).

zipcode.description: Site address ZIP from column site_addr_3, parsed as integer (first five digits; ZIP+4 uses base ZIP). (FK to zipcode_area is not modeled here — har_model zipcode_area has no hcad_real_accts array.)

yr_impr.description: Year of improvement when present; source 0 or blank → omit field.

yr_annexed.description: Annexation year when present; source 0 or blank → omit field.

hcad_real_acct.description: HCAD real account / owner roll extract. Primary key hcad_account (roll account number). One row per account per tax year in typical extracts; record_id optional line surrogate.

mls_number.description: MLS (Multiple Listing Service) number - unique identifier for the property

linked_mls_number.description:
Optional MLS number of the companion listing when the same real property is listed
separately for sale and for rent (two MLS records). References property.mls_number.
Omit when unknown or when the listing is not paired.

zipcode.description: ZIP code as integer - foreign key reference to zipcode.zipcode

url.description: URL to the property detail page on HAR.com

listing_date.description: Date the property was listed (ISO format YYYY-MM-DD, 'Just Listed', or MM/DD/YY format). Derived from 'X Day(s) on Market' when available.

auction_dates.description: Auction dates for foreclosure properties (format: MM/DD/YY-MM/DD/YY)

address.description: Street address details for this property

detail.description: Physical characteristics and details for this property

geolocation.description: Geolocation data including coordinates, elevation, flood zone, and fault proximity

media.description: Images and media associated with this property

metadata.description: Extraction and tracking metadata for this property

economics.description: Economic information for this property including list/sale pricing and maintenance fees

rental.description: Lease / monthly rent when the listing is marketed for rent (see property_rental.monthly_rent)

property_schools.description: School associations for this property, with separate links to elementary, middle, and high schools by school_id

property.description:
Core property listing information from HAR.com foreclosure search results.
Contains the primary identifier, basic listing details, and pricing.

street_number.description: Street number portion of the property address (as integer)

street.description: Street name portion of the property address (may include unit suffix, e.g. '#1502')

zipcode.description: ZIP code as integer (first five digits when sourced from address text)

site_address.description:
Structured site location key: street number, street name, and ZIP (5-digit integer).
Used for matching to external parcel rolls (e.g. HCAD) and deduplication; city/state remain separate fields.

hcad_accounts.description:
Matched Harris County roll rows (see hcad-real-acct-model.yaml). Each item is keyed by hcad_account;
filled by har_model/hcad_lookup.py from Real_acct_owner/real_acct.txt.

property_address.description:
Street address details for the property.
Linked to property via mls_number foreign key (one-to-one relationship).

sqft.description: Living area square footage (from listing card or HAR Building Size on detail page)

building_size.description: Raw Building Size line from HAR homedetail (e.g. sqft source and /Appraisal District)

lot_size_sqft.description: Lot size in square feet as integer

year_built.description: Year the property was built (parsed four-digit year)

year_built_raw.description: Full Year Built value from HAR (e.g. year plus appraisal district suffix)

stories.description: Number of stories (HAR homedetail Stories field)

garages.description: Garage count and style from HAR (e.g. spaces and attached/detached)

property_detail.description:
Physical characteristics and specifications of the property.
Linked to property via mls_number foreign key.

mls_number.description: Foreign key reference to property.mls_number and property_detail.mls_number (for computed field access)

price.description:
List / sale price in dollars when the listing is for sale (or sale+rent with sale as primary).
Use 0 when the listing is for rent/lease only — advertised rent is in property_rental.monthly_rent.

price_per_sqft.description: Price per square foot (calculated as price / sqft from property_detail)

opportunity_zone.description: Foreign key reference to geographic_area.area_id if property is located within an opportunity zone

monthly_maintenance_fee.description: Monthly maintenance fee in dollars (as integer)

property_economics.description:
Economic information for the property, including list/sale pricing, calculated metrics, and maintenance fees.
Advertised monthly rent is modeled on property_rental (property.rental).
Linked to property via mls_number foreign key.

elevation_ft.description: Elevation in feet above sea level (from USGS)

flood_zone.description: FEMA flood zone designation (A/AE/AH/AO/A99/AR = Special Flood Hazard, V/VE = Coastal High Hazard, X = Minimal Risk, D = Undetermined)

nearest_fault_meters.description: Distance to nearest fault line in meters

nearest_fault_id.description: Foreign key reference to fault.id - the nearest fault key point

property_geolocation.description:
Geographic coordinates, elevation, flood zone, and fault proximity data.
Linked to property via mls_number foreign key.

images.description: Array of image URLs for the property

property_media.description:
Images and media associated with the property listing.
Linked to property via mls_number foreign key.

extracted_at.description: ISO timestamp when the property was extracted

details_fetched_at.description: ISO timestamp when detail page data was fetched

property_metadata.description:
Metadata about when and how the property data was extracted.
Linked to property via mls_number foreign key.

mls_number.description: Foreign key reference to property.mls_number and property_detail.mls_number (for computed field access)

monthly_rent.description:
Advertised monthly rent in dollars for lease/rental listings.
For rent-only listings, the HAR card amount is stored here; property_economics.price is 0.

rent_per_sqft.description: Monthly rent per square foot (calculated as monthly_rent / sqft from property_detail)

property_rental.description:
Rental economics for the property when marketed for lease (including rent-only listings).
Linked to property via mls_number foreign key (nested under property.rental).
Sale / list price remains on property_economics.price; use price 0 for rent-only listings.

elementary_school_id.description: Foreign key reference to school.school_id for the elementary school assigned to this property

middle_school_id.description: Foreign key reference to school.school_id for the middle school assigned to this property

high_school_id.description: Foreign key reference to school.school_id for the high school assigned to this property

property_schools.description:
Links properties to schools at each of the three school levels (elementary, middle, high).
Each property can have one school assigned at each level, referenced by school_id.
Schools can be linked to multiple properties.

school_id.description: Unique school identifier from HAR.com (extracted from URL pattern: /school/{school_id}/...)

grade.description: School letter grade (A, B, C, D, or F)

latitude.description: School latitude coordinate (decimal degrees) - geolocation data for the school

longitude.description: School longitude coordinate (decimal degrees) - geolocation data for the school

city.description: City where the school is located

state.description: State abbreviation where the school is located (e.g., 'TX')

zipcode.description: ZIP code where the school is located

area_id.description: Foreign key reference to geographic_area.area_id (school district/school zone)

school.description:
School information extracted from HAR.com property detail pages.
Includes elementary, middle, and high schools. Each school can be linked to
multiple properties. Schools have their own geolocation data (latitude, longitude).
Schools are referenced by properties via school_id foreign key.

profile_id.description: Unique identifier for the search profile. Used as the primary key to store and retrieve search configurations.

min.description: Minimum price filter in dollars. If omitted, no minimum price constraint is applied. Properties with prices at or above this value will match.

max.description: Maximum price filter in dollars. If omitted, no maximum price constraint is applied. Properties with prices at or below this value will match.

price.description: Price range filter. If omitted, no price constraints are applied. Both min and max subcomponents are optional - if min is omitted, no minimum price constraint is applied; if max is omitted, no maximum price constraint is applied.

min.description: Minimum monthly maintenance fee filter in dollars. If omitted, no minimum maintenance fee constraint is applied. Properties with maintenance fees at or above this value will match.

max.description: Maximum monthly maintenance fee filter in dollars. If omitted, no maximum maintenance fee constraint is applied. Properties with maintenance fees at or below this value will match.

maintenance_fee.description: Monthly maintenance fee range filter. If omitted, no maintenance fee constraints are applied. Both min and max subcomponents are optional - if min is omitted, no minimum maintenance fee constraint is applied; if max is omitted, no maximum maintenance fee constraint is applied.

property_types.description: Filter list of property types to include in search. Valid values: Condo, Land, Multi-Family, Single-Family, Townhouse. If omitted or empty, all property types will match. Only properties with types in this list will be included in search results.

zipcodes.description: Filter list of ZIP codes to search within. If omitted or empty, all ZIP codes will match. Only properties in the specified ZIP codes will be included in search results.

elementary.description: Minimum school grade filter for elementary schools (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'C'). If omitted, no elementary school grade constraint is applied. Only properties with elementary schools rated at or above this grade will match.

middle.description: Minimum school grade filter for middle schools (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'C'). If omitted, no middle school grade constraint is applied. Only properties with middle schools rated at or above this grade will match.

high.description: Minimum school grade filter for high schools (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'C'). If omitted, no high school grade constraint is applied. Only properties with high schools rated at or above this grade will match.

school_grade.description: School grade filter for elementary, middle, and high school levels. If omitted, no school grade constraints are applied. Each subcomponent is optional - if a level is omitted, no grade constraint is applied for that level. Only properties with schools matching the specified grades at each level will be included in search results. Valid grade values: A, B, C, D, F.

opportunity_zone_only.description: If true, only show properties located in opportunity zones. If false or omitted, properties in both opportunity zones and non-opportunity zones will match.

search_profile.description:
Search profile defining property search criteria including price range, maintenance fee range,
property types, zip codes, school grade filters, and opportunity zone filter. Used to save and reuse search configurations.

x-storage.description: Storage type for entity data. INDEXED_KV uses CloudFlare Key-Value store with an index key (entityname:index) containing the primary key values of value keys (entityname:primary_key_1, ...). GITHUB_PR uses GitHub pull request storage.

state.description: State information with abbreviation as primary key.

properties.description: Properties located in this ZIP code

zipcode.description:
ZIP code location details including city, state, and county.
Linked to property via property.zipcode foreign key as parent.
Linked to city via name foreign key as parent.

crime_statistics.description: Crime statistics for this ZIP code area (one record per ZIP code)

demographics.description: Demographic statistics for this ZIP code area

zipcode_area.description:
Reference entity for ZIP code areas, linking crime statistics and demographics.
Each ZIP code can have multiple neighborhoods, but demographics are at the ZIP code level.
Geographic areas reference zipcodes through their zip_codes array field.

change.description: Change log entry describing a versioned modification to the consolidated data model or data.

git_commit_hash.description: Git commit hash corresponding to this change
